rows: ECX Game; plain RET. Iterate players0..11: controller player268==1 and slot state270==1 create retained Town AI at current difficulty26c; always create player12 with difficulty1. Membership availability precedes StartCampaignAI, verified public configured computer0 and neutral12/15 controls; other controller mutations remain unverified.

ECX Player, stack4 difficulty; RET4. Town factory9c54e0 receives player30 and difficulty. Resolve canonical class2b61676c, retain Town identity in player2d4/2d8 or ffffffff on unresolved result. Decompiled fastcall signature omits the actual stack argument; ABI confirmed from assembly.

ECX Unit, stack4 Boolean; RET4. Walk live ability identities1dc/1e0 and next24/28. For ability3c<=0 set/clear ability20 bit2, then invoke c8/c4 respectively. Enrollment and owner transfer controls observe this boundary; complete per-ability side effects remain GROUP03.2.

ECX Unit; plain RET/tail resolve. Return NULL for identity304/308 all-ones, otherwise resolve payload. Help recipient66e9e0 tests this pointer to distinguish ordinary victim-self from an AI recipient; AI flag5c.4 is a distinct field, not this identity. Wider record lifecycle remains open.
ECX Unit; plain RET. Return unit24c, CUnit vtable114 getter. AI membership9b9230 excludes targeted-as ward bit10, independently of dead unit5c.100. This is not the collision/category query mask.

Public configured computer0 is enrolled before AI script startup and on fresh creation afterward; owner12 is enrolled without a script and owner15 is not. Dead/ward gate precedes retained player Town resolution and prepend. Set unit5c.4 only upon valid Town membership. Engine Save129 retains per-map availability and per-instance enrollment; ability AI hooks and broader record producers remain open.

Genuine owner transfer publishes owner event first, then disables ability AI mode67dff0(0), clears unit5c.4 through6991b0 and reenrolls9b9230. Same-owner returns without these transitions. Complete repeated public 0->2,2->2,2->0 controls preserve an already armed help suppression deadline across transfer.

AI unit5c.4 with source and packet bit4 clear calls695030(victim self,source) before ordinary fc damage notifications, independently of help suppression. Repeated AH153 tick11 retains the self alert while no new radius query runs. Ordinary help follows; engine self cap notification and saved AI help policy integrated, wider damage/engagement guards remain open.

AH153 public repeats: configured computer0 radius900/delay0.5 before/after StartCampaignAI; real transfer2 radius173/delay3, return0 restores900/0.5. Owners12/15 both use authored creep229, but only enrolled12 uses0.5; passive15 uses3. Query includes victim self only with AI record, while direct damage self alert is separate. AI propagation90/94 and Town/captain event behavior remain open.
